mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT pool_id FROM ip_pool_auto_rule WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND task_code = #{taskCode} AND rule_type = #{ruleType} AND pool_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pool_id ASC

SELECT ips.security_code ,ips.security_short_name ,ips.security_type FROM ip_pool_status ips INNER JOIN rrs_securityinfo si ON si.wind_code = ips.security_code INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = ips.security_type AND dst.is_deleted = 0 AND dst.category_type IN ('bond', 'stock') WHERE ips.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 AND ips.security_type != 'crmw' AND si.maturity_date IS NOT NULL AND si.maturity_date != '' AND si.maturity_date < DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT bond.wind_code AS security_code ,bond.short_name AS security_short_name ,bond.security_type FROM rrs_securityinfo bond INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = bond.security_type AND dst.is_deleted = 0 AND dst.category_type = 'bond' WHERE bond.issuer_code IS NOT NULL AND bond.issuer_code != '' AND (bond.maturity_date IS NULL OR bond.maturity_date > CURDATE()) AND COALESCE(bond.abs_flag, 0) != 1 AND bond.security_type != 'crmw' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status cps INNER JOIN dict_security_type cdst ON cdst.security_type = cps.security_type AND cdst.is_deleted = 0 AND cdst.category_type = 'company' WHERE cps.security_code = bond.issuer_code AND cps.target_pool_id = #{companyPoolId} AND cps.audit_status = '20' AND cps.is_deleted = 0 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status bps WHERE bps.security_code = bond.wind_code AND bps.target_pool_id = #{targetPoolId} AND bps.audit_status = '20' AND bps.is_deleted = 0 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM rrs_temp_security_code ts WHERE ts.temp_security_code = bond.wind_code AND ts.security_code IS NOT NULL AND ts.security_code != '' AND IFNULL(ts.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND ts.status = 'updated' ) ORDER BY bond.wind_code ASC

SELECT bond.wind_code AS security_code ,bond.short_name AS security_short_name ,bond.security_type FROM rrs_securityinfo bond INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = bond.security_type AND dst.is_deleted = 0 AND dst.category_type = 'bond' INNER JOIN ip_investment_pool p ON p.id = #{poolId} AND IFNULL(p.is_deleted, 0) = 0 WHERE bond.issuer_code IS NOT NULL AND bond.issuer_code != '' AND (bond.maturity_date IS NULL OR bond.maturity_date >= CURDATE()) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status cps INNER JOIN dict_security_type cdst ON cdst.security_type = cps.security_type AND cdst.is_deleted = 0 AND cdst.category_type = 'company' WHERE cps.security_code = bond.issuer_code AND cps.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND cps.audit_status = '20' AND cps.is_deleted = 0 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status bps WHERE bps.security_code = bond.wind_code AND bps.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND bps.audit_status = '20' AND bps.is_deleted = 0 ) AND ( p.market_codes IS NULL OR p.market_codes = '' OR p.market_codes = '[]' OR ( (JSON_CONTAINS(p.market_codes, '"SSE"') AND bond.wind_code_sh IS NOT NULL AND bond.wind_code_sh != '') OR (JSON_CONTAINS(p.market_codes, '"SZSE"') AND bond.wind_code_sz IS NOT NULL AND bond.wind_code_sz != '') OR (JSON_CONTAINS(p.market_codes, '"CIBM"') AND bond.wind_code_nib IS NOT NULL AND bond.wind_code_nib != '') OR (JSON_CONTAINS(p.market_codes, '"BSE"') AND bond.wind_code_bj IS NOT NULL AND bond.wind_code_bj != '') OR (JSON_CONTAINS(p.market_codes, '"OTHER"') AND bond.wind_code_nbc IS NOT NULL AND bond.wind_code_nbc != '') OR (JSON_CONTAINS(p.market_codes, '"JWCW"') AND ( (bond.wind_code_nib IS NOT NULL AND bond.wind_code_nib != '') OR (bond.wind_code_nbc IS NOT NULL AND bond.wind_code_nbc != '') )) ) ) ORDER BY bond.wind_code ASC

WITH rated AS ( SELECT r.s_info_compcode ,r.s_info_compname ,r.b_info_creditrating ,COALESCE(NULLIF(r.ann_dt2, ''), NULLIF(r.ann_dt, ''), '00000000') AS declare_dt ,CASE TRIM(r.b_info_creditrating) WHEN 'AAA+' THEN 21 WHEN 'AAA' THEN 20 WHEN 'AA+' THEN 19 WHEN 'AA' THEN 18 WHEN 'AA-' THEN 17 WHEN 'A+' THEN 16 WHEN 'A' THEN 15 WHEN 'A-' THEN 14 WHEN 'BBB+' THEN 13 WHEN 'BBB' THEN 12 WHEN 'BBB-' THEN 11 WHEN 'BB+' THEN 10 WHEN 'BB' THEN 9 WHEN 'BB-' THEN 8 WHEN 'B+' THEN 7 WHEN 'B' THEN 6 WHEN 'B-' THEN 5 WHEN 'CCC' THEN 4 WHEN 'CC' THEN 3 WHEN 'C' THEN 2 WHEN 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS rating_value FROM ais_inv_ods.wind_cbondissuerrating r WHERE r.s_info_compcode IS NOT NULL AND r.s_info_compcode != '' AND r.b_info_creditrating IS NOT NULL AND r.b_info_creditrating != '' )
,old_pick AS ( SELECT s_info_compcode ,s_info_compname ,b_info_creditrating ,declare_dt ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY s_info_compcode ORDER BY declare_dt DESC ,rating_value DESC ) AS rn FROM rated WHERE declare_dt < DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH), '%Y%m%d') )
,recent_pick AS ( SELECT s_info_compcode ,s_info_compname ,b_info_creditrating ,declare_dt ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY s_info_compcode ORDER BY rating_value DESC ) AS rn FROM rated WHERE declare_dt >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH), '%Y%m%d') )
,merged AS ( SELECT s_info_compcode, s_info_compname, b_info_creditrating, declare_dt FROM old_pick WHERE rn = 1 UNION ALL SELECT s_info_compcode, s_info_compname, b_info_creditrating, declare_dt FROM recent_pick WHERE rn = 1 )
SELECT t.s_info_compcode AS security_code ,COALESCE(NULLIF(t.s_info_compname, ''), t.s_info_compcode) AS security_short_name ,'company' AS security_type FROM ( SELECT s_info_compcode ,s_info_compname ,b_info_creditrating ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY s_info_compcode ORDER BY declare_dt DESC ) AS rn FROM merged ) t WHERE t.rn = 1 AND t.b_info_creditrating IN ( 'AA-', 'A+', 'A', 'A-' ,'BBB+', 'BBB', 'BBB-' ,'BB+', 'BB', 'BB-' ,'B+', 'B', 'B-' ,'CCC', 'CC', 'C' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status ips WHERE ips.security_code = t.s_info_compcode AND ips.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 ) ORDER BY t.s_info_compcode ASC

WITH rated AS ( SELECT r.s_info_compcode ,r.s_info_compname ,r.b_info_creditrating ,COALESCE(NULLIF(r.ann_dt2, ''), NULLIF(r.ann_dt, ''), '00000000') AS declare_dt ,CASE TRIM(r.b_info_creditrating) WHEN 'AAA+' THEN 21 WHEN 'AAA' THEN 20 WHEN 'AA+' THEN 19 WHEN 'AA' THEN 18 WHEN 'AA-' THEN 17 WHEN 'A+' THEN 16 WHEN 'A' THEN 15 WHEN 'A-' THEN 14 WHEN 'BBB+' THEN 13 WHEN 'BBB' THEN 12 WHEN 'BBB-' THEN 11 WHEN 'BB+' THEN 10 WHEN 'BB' THEN 9 WHEN 'BB-' THEN 8 WHEN 'B+' THEN 7 WHEN 'B' THEN 6 WHEN 'B-' THEN 5 WHEN 'CCC' THEN 4 WHEN 'CC' THEN 3 WHEN 'C' THEN 2 WHEN 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS rating_value FROM ais_inv_ods.wind_cbondissuerrating r WHERE r.s_info_compcode IS NOT NULL AND r.s_info_compcode != '' AND r.b_info_creditrating IS NOT NULL AND r.b_info_creditrating != '' )
,old_pick AS ( SELECT s_info_compcode ,s_info_compname ,b_info_creditrating ,declare_dt ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY s_info_compcode ORDER BY declare_dt DESC ,rating_value DESC ) AS rn FROM rated WHERE declare_dt < DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH), '%Y%m%d') )
,recent_pick AS ( SELECT s_info_compcode ,s_info_compname ,b_info_creditrating ,declare_dt ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY s_info_compcode ORDER BY rating_value DESC ) AS rn FROM rated WHERE declare_dt >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH), '%Y%m%d') )
,merged AS ( SELECT s_info_compcode, s_info_compname, b_info_creditrating, declare_dt FROM old_pick WHERE rn = 1 UNION ALL SELECT s_info_compcode, s_info_compname, b_info_creditrating, declare_dt FROM recent_pick WHERE rn = 1 )
SELECT t.s_info_compcode AS security_code ,COALESCE(NULLIF(t.s_info_compname, ''), t.s_info_compcode) AS security_short_name ,'company' AS security_type FROM ( SELECT s_info_compcode ,s_info_compname ,b_info_creditrating ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY s_info_compcode ORDER BY declare_dt DESC ) AS rn FROM merged ) t WHERE t.rn = 1 AND t.b_info_creditrating NOT IN ( 'AA-', 'A+', 'A', 'A-' ,'BBB+', 'BBB', 'BBB-' ,'BB+', 'BB', 'BB-' ,'B+', 'B', 'B-' ,'CCC', 'CC', 'C' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status ips WHERE ips.security_code = t.s_info_compcode AND ips.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ips.security_type = 'company' AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status lim WHERE lim.security_code = t.s_info_compcode AND lim.security_type = 'company' AND lim.audit_status = '20' AND lim.is_deleted = 0 AND lim.target_pool_id IN
#{limitPoolId}
)
ORDER BY t.s_info_compcode ASC

SELECT bond.wind_code AS security_code ,bond.short_name AS security_short_name ,bond.security_type FROM rrs_securityinfo bond INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = bond.security_type AND dst.is_deleted = 0 AND dst.category_type = 'bond' INNER JOIN ip_pool_status ips ON ips.security_code = bond.wind_code AND ips.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 WHERE bond.issuer_code = #{companyCode} ORDER BY bond.wind_code ASC

SELECT ips.security_code ,ips.security_short_name ,ips.security_type ,ips.crmw_name ,ips.crmw_scode ,ips.crmw_mktcode ,ips.crmw_stype FROM ip_pool_status_crmw ips INNER JOIN rrs_securityinfo crmw ON crmw.wind_code = ips.crmw_scode WHERE ips.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 AND ips.pool_type = 'crmw' AND crmw.security_type = 'crmw' AND crmw.maturity_date IS NOT NULL AND crmw.maturity_date != '' AND crmw.maturity_date < DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY ips.crmw_scode ASC ,ips.security_code ASC

SELECT bond.wind_code AS security_code ,bond.short_name AS security_short_name ,bond.security_type FROM ip_pool_status ips INNER JOIN rrs_securityinfo bond ON bond.wind_code = ips.security_code INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = bond.security_type AND dst.is_deleted = 0 AND dst.category_type = 'bond' WHERE ips.target_pool_id = #{bondPoolId} AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 AND COALESCE(bond.abs_flag, 0) != 1 AND bond.security_type != 'crmw' AND bond.issuer_code IS NOT NULL AND bond.issuer_code != '' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status cps INNER JOIN dict_security_type cdst ON cdst.security_type = cps.security_type AND cdst.is_deleted = 0 AND cdst.category_type = 'company' WHERE cps.security_code = bond.issuer_code AND cps.target_pool_id = #{companyPoolId} AND cps.audit_status = '20' AND cps.is_deleted = 0 ) ORDER BY bond.wind_code ASC
